CommunityApplications.Profile: TT Travel Planner is a self-hosted, real-time collaborative travel planner. Plan trips together with interactive maps, budgets, bookings, packing lists, day-by-day itineraries and file management — every change syncs instantly across everyone in your group. Includes OIDC/SSO, TOTP MFA, dark mode, PWA support, multi-language UI and a modular addon system. Maintained by the TT project — support and bug reports via GitHub Issues.
